summary: One read-only Codex cold read (gpt-5.6-terra, task-mu2anfk4-8pabuq) of docs/specs/all-plants-statement.md against the built repo. Three factual corrections and five questions. Four of the five were settled from the repository (plant identity keeps the shipped DUB canonical id; the budget upload takes an explicit plant field because the client's workbook names no owning plant; the format outline becomes a pinnable object separate from any plant budget; only master-configured selections are offered). Two went to the human in one round: acceptance of decision 0029 with its supersession of 0016, and the partial-FY-YTD Budget/% rule. The spec was amended once and this pass is bound to the amended digest.
gaps: Company-wide July net is ₹11,02,73,718.00 in exact paise, not .07 as the draft's acceptance criterion 1 stated (the .07 belongs to DUB alone); coverage is 92.7% and the eleven unmatched cost-centre-plus-GL pairs include Primary/50001802 and Tertiary/50001904, which DUB never books and were therefore never bucketed for DUB.
Decision 0029 was still proposed while accepted decision 0016 restricts the governed join to the single plant DUB; the spec cannot be confirmed against a live corpus that contradicts it.
Plant identity was ambiguous: the draft said the SAP plant code is canonical yet called DUB-NUR an alias of DUB, while the shipped master, seeded scopes, budget ownership and drill pins key on DUB.

The budget upload's plant had no falsifiable source: the format workbook's Plant list names sixteen plants, the parser hard-codes DUB, and 'the workbook names its plant' named no field and no mismatch rule.

The outline for a no-budget plant was not an object that exists: outlines live only under a budget batch (decision 0021) and the drill requires a pinned budget batch, so 'the format's active outline' could not be pinned.
Partial FY-YTD budgets were underspecified: summing the loaded budget months left open whether % compares a partial budget to full-block actuals.

The draft said a plant absent from the master renders 'no mapping configured', but such a plant can never appear in the cascading dropdowns, and independent Department/Function/Plant lists could form combinations the master does not hold.
contradictions: Spec versus accepted decision 0016: the governed relation is DUB-only in 0016 while the spec carries plant as a scoped dimension across every granted plant.
Spec versus itself on plant identity: 'SAP plant code is canonical' contradicted 'DUB-NUR keeps its alias to DUB'.
resolutions: Why and acceptance criterion 1 now carry the exact-paise figures: ₹11,02,73,718.00 company-wide, ₹10,21,80,290.32 matched (92.7%), ₹80,93,427.68 unmatched, and the eleven pairs are described as nine already bucketed for DUB plus the two DUB never books.

HUMAN ROUND: decision 0029 accepted, confirmed by Rahul Anand, with an explicit supersedes pointer to 0016 and a clause restating what 0016 keeps (join key gl_code + month, full-outer zero-fill, two-sided scope, the deferred mapping master and its trigger) now within each granted plant. Recorded with `forge decision accept` before this pass.

Repository-resolved: the master's plant_canonical is the identity. DUB stays DUB with SAP alias DUB-NUR exactly as shipped (mis-selection, seeded scope, budget, pins all key on it); every other plant's canonical id is its SAP code with no alias. Written into Behaviour and decision 0029 clause 6.

Repository-resolved: the budget upload takes an explicit canonical plant id as a request field, validated against the master, and the parser stops assuming DUB; the current nursery workbook is re-imported once with plant DUB. Acceptance criterion 6 refuses a missing or unknown plant and an outline mismatch.

Repository-resolved: the format outline becomes a pinnable object independent of any plant's budget amounts; plant budgets attach to it and must match it leaf-for-leaf by stable leaf key; the statement and the drill pin it explicitly and separately from any plant budget batch. Persistence shape is left to the plan. Acceptance criterion 7 names the pinned outline object.

HUMAN ROUND: partial FY-YTD renders Budget as the sum over months that have a budget batch, naming them in the block heading, and % as the dash whenever any month with actuals in the block lacks a budget. Written into Behaviour, decision 0029 clause 4, and acceptance criterion 9's two-month fixture.

Repository-resolved: dropdowns cascade from the master's configured selections filtered by grants (SelectionResolverService.options() already does this); a plant in a later actuals upload but absent from the master is not offered, is named in the upload's validation result, and is added as master data; a direct unconfigured request fails closed with the existing no-mapping outcome. New acceptance criterion 10.
Residency: decision 0027 governs unchanged; the spec's 'what does not change' list now cites it so the model boundary (vocabulary yes, amounts and rows never) is not re-opened by adding plants.
open_items: Non-blocking: the client's authoritative Department / Function names and Master Table (renames the provisional labels, empties the bucket as data).
Non-blocking: budgets for plants other than the nursery.
Non-blocking: format Plant list names that do not match SAP (DHS, DHS2 versus DMHS; Belagum absent from July) — to confirm with Srihari.

rounds.question: Decision 0029 (every SAP plant selectable on the nursery format, provisional labels, absent budget as a dash) must be accepted before the spec can be confirmed. It supersedes decision 0016's 'single plant DUB' join scope while restating its join key (GL code + month, now within each granted plant) and its deferred mapping-master clause. Accept it as written, confirmed by Rahul Anand?
FY-YTD block on a plant whose budget covers only some of the months in the block: how should Budget and % render? (Today only July is loaded, so the DUB YTD block is unaffected either way.)
options: Budget and % both over loaded months only
